quote: There are more things likely to frighten us than to crush us; we suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
source: Seneca, Letters from a Stoic, XIII
original: Plura sunt quae nos terrent quam quae premunt.

quote: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste much of it.
source: Seneca, On the Shortness of Life
original: Non exiguum temporis habemus, sed multum perdidimus.

quote: Do not act as if you had ten thousand years to throw away. While you live, while you can, be good.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
Men are disturbed not by things, but by the views they take of things.
Vanity of vanities; all is vanity.
The best ideas come from connecting things that aren't supposed to be connected.
